newsitem.title: UK: BAe gets go ahead for Canada Hawk deal.
newsitem.headline: BAe gets go ahead for Canada Hawk deal.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc said on Wednesday it will supply Hawk 100 training aircraft to Canada, following the country's decision to proceed with a NATO flying training programme.

BAe will now start negotiations for up to 25 aircraft, which will be built at its factories at Brough in the north east of England and Warton in the north west. Bae will also supply aircraft spares, initial pilot and technical training as well as design and engineering services.
A BAe spokesman said terms of the deal were still under negotiation and no financial details would be disclosed.
